declared: pre-analysis specification §4h (2026-10-30), fixed before any model call of the benchmark
what: Gaps in a codebook version that a human documented after that version was written: the changes the calibration sessions forced (tools/annotation/codebook/README.md, version table and rules X10/X11 of v0.3, the split and the comparison change of v1.0) and the general-category ambiguity recorded on 2026-10-14 (tools/annotation/labels/README.md). An item belongs to a session only if the problem exists in that session's codebook text.
matching: An item counts as found in a run if at least one reported issue describes the same problem as the item's criterion, whatever words or ids it uses; naming the same element for a different problem does not count. A run may match several items with one issue.

G01.criterion: A category for the technical feasibility, maturity or performance of a technology (whether it can be built or works, its efficiency, yield or potential) is missing, or statements of this kind have no fitting element.

G02.criterion: A category for land or area use, siting, landscape, visual impact or local amenity (including local opposition to a site) is missing, or such statements have no fitting element.

G03.criterion: A category for regulation, permitting, planning or legal procedure is missing, or such statements have no fitting element.

G04.found_by_humans: session A0 -> v0.2 fixed the no_frame_present rule
G04.criterion: The no-frame rule does not separate 'the paragraph performs no framing' from 'the paragraph frames, but no listed element fits', so framing outside the list would be recorded as no frame (or pushed into the residual).

G05.found_by_humans: session A0b (2026-08-29) -> v0.3 boundary rule F5a/F6b
G05.criterion: The boundary between intermittency or availability (F5a) and technical performance or yield (F6b) is undecided for output changes, e.g. lower output caused by weather versus by design or site.

G06.found_by_humans: session A0b -> v0.3 rule X10; calibration prevalence -> v1.0 split of F2b into F2b and F2c
G06.criterion: Growth, record or decline statistics on deployment, output or market share are not clearly assigned (to the investment/industry element or to no frame), or the investment/industry/competitiveness element is too broad and mixes investment claims with deployment statistics.

G07.criterion: The technology field does not say whether to tick only the technologies the paragraph itself names or also technologies implied by world knowledge (for example everything a named law or programme covers).

G09.found_by_humans: calibration A0 + A0b -> v1.0 comparison field admits the studied technologies
G09.criterion: The comparison target cannot name one of the studied technologies, so a technology-against-technology comparison (solar against wind, renewables against nuclear) cannot be coded, or the exclusion of studied technologies from the comparison list / its tie-break is problematic.

G10.found_by_humans: first coding of A2/A3, recorded 2026-10-14 (labels README); the definition is identical in v0.1, v0.2 and v1.0
G10.criterion: The general category's definition (renewables or the transition 'as a bundle, with no identifiable individual technology carrying the statement') does not decide what to do when a bundle term carries a statement in a paragraph that also names individual technologies: tick general per statement, or only as a residual when no individual technology is identifiable.

secondary.why: The three elements with the lowest intra-coder stability under v1.0 (alpha 0.369, 0.462, 0.598); reported as the share of runs whose issues name each element, beside the other elements, descriptively.
